identity.label: Identity
identity.asserts: It is one reconciled identity, not a name in one registry.

criteria.0: Referenced somewhere (a skill target, a profession role) but present in no identity registry.
criteria.1: Present in exactly one registry — canonical-only, or roster-only with no canonical mapping.
criteria.2: Present and bridged across registries, but not marked active.
criteria.3: Bridged AND registry status is active.

corpus.label: Corpus / WSID
corpus.asserts: It can reach its profession's craft corpus before deciding.

criteria.1: Bound to a family that has no corpus pages.
criteria.2: Corpus pages exist, but evaluate_profession_decision is unreachable (missing grant).
criteria.3: Corpus pages exist and the retrieval tool is reachable.

governance.label: Governance / WWWD
governance.asserts: It can consult the kernel, and has somewhere to escalate.

criteria.1: Holds grants, but principle_decide is unreachable.
criteria.3: Reachable AND a human supervisor or escalation target is declared.

shape.label: Shape
shape.asserts: Its work has declared stages and gates.

criteria.1: A shape is named but has no stages or gates.
criteria.3: Declared, and instances of the shape are running.

cadence.label: Cadence

cadence.blocker: No skill can declare a cadence (0 of 67 have a recurring taskType). Ceiling rises to 3 when it lands.

criteria.0: No recurring trigger — any Proactivity setting is a silent no-op.
criteria.1: Named by a scheduled job, but owns no self-task of its own.
criteria.2: Has a COWORKER_SELF_TASKS entry driven by its Proactivity setting.
criteria.3: Self-task PLUS a cadence declared on the skill itself.

toolsAndSkills.label: Tools + Skills
toolsAndSkills.asserts: It has skills authored for it and tools it can actually call.

criteria.1: Grants or wildcard skills only — nothing authored for this agent.
criteria.2: At least one directly-assigned skill and at least one reachable tool.
criteria.3: As level 2, and every backingSkillId on its services resolves to a real skill.

evidence.label: Evidence
evidence.asserts: Certification exercises a real domain act, not a generic probe.
evidence.blocker: A passing AssuranceRun is runtime state a static scan cannot see. Ceiling rises to 3 when the measure reads the ledger.

criteria.0: Not in the certification set at all.
criteria.1: Generic derivedReadProbe only — passes with zero domain capability.
criteria.2: A curated golden journey exercising a real domain act.
criteria.3: Curated journey with a recorded passing AssuranceRun.
